_comment: Bandcamp has been cut from the site — no purchase links, no album cards. What remains is the release metadata the meditation library needs: which collection a track belongs to, and that release's cover art. Descriptions are verbatim from the releases. (The I Am Worthy shoot photo moved to the About page.)

dawning-of-a-new-day.title: Dawning of a New Day
dawning-of-a-new-day.coverAlt: Cover art for Dawning of a New Day by Mayana Geathers
dawning-of-a-new-day.description: The Dawning of a New Day is my new collection of guided meditations. In this collection I visit many topics, such as trauma, self worth, connecting with your inner child and releasing beliefs that no longer are constructive. In this collection, I aim to empower, to uplift, and to encourage reflection.
dawning-of-a-new-day._comment_description: Transcribed from the release page; the text was cut off mid-sentence in the screenshot, so CONFIRM the closing line.

i-am-worthy.title: I Am Worthy
i-am-worthy.coverAlt: Cover art for I Am Worthy by Mayana Geathers
i-am-worthy.description: I Am Worthy is a collection of original guided meditations. These selections take you on a journey that centers around self worth, as it holds space for grief, self, grounding and rest. Listen all the way through, or choose the guided imagery that fits you in the moment. I Am Worthy is a tool to compliment your self-care practice.
i-am-worthy.credits: All guided imageries written and voiced by Mayana Geathers. Music composed by David Geathers.
